---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to a PocketBI workflow or public documentation
title: "[Feature] "
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""
---

## Product

Which PocketBI product or workflow is this about?

## Job to be done

What are you trying to accomplish?

## Current workflow

How do you do it today?

## Friction

What is slow, repetitive, confusing, or impossible?

## Desired outcome

What would a successful workflow look like?

## Frequency

One-time / daily / weekly / monthly / recurring business process / other

## Example

Use synthetic or sanitized examples only. Do not include credentials, confidential datasets, or private customer information.

## Additional context

Screenshots or diagrams are welcome if they contain no sensitive data.
